# ETS -> real Theben Meteodata 1409207 (1.1.202) System 7 (mask 0701) flash:
# request-direction TPDUs, memory-mapped LSM realisation. Source: real ETS
# download capture (shared-with-windows/meteodata-140-s-download.pcapng), app
# M-0048_A-140C (Meteodata 140 S). Each line: <src_ia_hex> <dst_ia_hex> <tpdu_hex>.
# Requests only (L_Data.req). The real device address is rewritten to 1105
# (1.1.5) so this committed fixture carries NO real individual address, only the
# load-control + memory shape.
#
# This is the MEMORY-MAPPED-LSM oracle for the knx-sim System 7 calibration test
# and the 0701-family counterpart of sys7_jung_flash_requests.txt (which pins the
# property/PID-5 realisation of the Jung 0705 family). It pins the Theben 0701
# verdict on the wire: load control is an 11-octet record written by
# A_Memory_Write to 0x0104 with the LSM index in the high nibble of octet 0
# (14/24/34 = Unload LSM1/2/3; 11/21/31 = StartLoading; 13.. = AbsSegment alloc;
# 1302.. = TaskSegment marker 48 140c 14; 3304.. = TaskCtrl1; 12/22/32 =
# LoadCompleted), status polled by A_Memory_Read at 0xB6EA + (lsm-1), and a bare
# 0x380 fire-and-forget restart. ZERO PID-5 traffic.
#
# The capture was a re-download (most memory already matched, so ETS wrote only
# deltas and read-verified the rest); this fixture keeps the clean load-control
# skeleton + the two real delta segment writes and renumbers the L4 sequence
# consecutively from the single load T_Connect so a FRESH sim device replays it
# to Loaded on LSM 1/2/3. Control frames: 80 = T_Connect, 81 = T_Disconnect,
# c2/c6/... = the tool's outgoing T_ACK (the sim ignores tool ACKs).
